experiment: SG27 comprehensive multi-resolution SA map fusion
ca: frozen SG24-A3 class-word W, selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all heads
sa: exact SG25 FINE-P2, 16-to-64, 32-to-64 paths; calls 10-20, all eight heads
normalization: independently minmax-normalize the three complete 64x64 base maps, apply fixed fusion formula, then minmax-normalize every final map once
duplicate_rule: max absolute difference of final normalized maps <1e-8 on all four frozen smoke samples; retain first numeric cell name
crf: unchanged R2 applied to every unique fusion cell
selection: five fixed VOC folds, raw and R2 screens separately against S0; full VOC thresholds frozen for COCO
storage: resumable per-image counts and reduced change/disagreement sidecars; no images, masks or attention matrices
